text: Accepted test_downloadOffline.js has setup, downloadAllForOffline and verifyDownloaded tasks. The final stream argument controls localOnly and the IDL documents that a required network load must fail when this is true. Scoped test pattern: separate setup, asynchronous action and verification, and explain an opaque positional boolean at the call boundary. This is specific to this message-service API, not a universal rule to split every test into three tasks. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.
